title: Pecan Waffles
changes_from_base: Finely ground pecans beaten into the batter, with 2 whole eggs plus 2 extra whisked whites; no sugar or vanilla.
summary: Nutty waffles made with finely ground pecans folded through a light, airy batter.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
egg whites, whisked to stiff peaks

steps.title: Sift
steps.text: Sift 190 g plain flour with salt to taste and 2 tsp baking powder.

steps.title: Beat
steps.text: Beat 2 whole eggs, then gradually beat in 330 ml milk and 56 g melted butter.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Add the flour mixture and whisk until smooth, then beat in 55 g finely ground pecans.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Whisk 2 egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them in gently to make about 1 litre of batter.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the right amount of batter for your iron, close the lid and cook as the iron's instructions say.

tips: Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks before folding them in, as this is what keeps the finished batter light despite the ground pecans.
Grind the pecans finely so they blend smoothly into the batter rather than leaving large pieces.
Fold the whisked whites in gently to keep as much air in the batter as possible.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the iron. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
